---
title: Editorial marks in mixed contexts
format: docx
---

Marks inside a list item, a block quote, a table cell, and a heading — each
of these is a distinct container in the pampa grammar, and each is worth an
OOXML round-trip test since Word's comment/track-changes XML ranges have to
nest correctly inside list paragraphs, quote paragraphs, and table cell
paragraphs.

## List item

- item

  ::: --

  removed from the list item.

  :::

- another item with an inline [>> should we keep this bullet? ] comment

## Block quote

> ::: ++
>
> added inside a block quote.
>
> :::

> A quoted sentence with [-- an inline deletion] and [!! a highlight] together.

## Table cell

| Column A | Column B |
|----------|----------|
| plain    | [++ inserted in a cell] |
| [-- deleted in a cell] | [>> flagged for review] |
